note: Curated model recommendations for the XSLOPE Studio assistant. Published as a release asset beside latest.json and read at most once a day, so the advice can be corrected between app releases. It only MARKS and ORDERS what the provider itself lists - nothing here hides a model, and any model id can still be typed into the dialog by hand. 'recommended' is what a fresh install selects; 'good_choices' sort to the top with the labels below; 'deprecated' ids stay selectable and are marked as superseded. Ollama is deliberately absent: its list is whatever the user has pulled locally.

good_choices.label: flagship
good_choices.note: Strongest on multi-step edits and long autonomous runs. Prompt caching keeps the large xslope system prompt cheap on repeat turns.

good_choices.label: balanced
good_choices.note: Near-flagship quality on coding and agentic work at a lower price per token.

good_choices.label: economical
good_choices.note: Fastest and cheapest. Good for short edits and quick questions about a model.

good_choices.label: flagship
good_choices.note: Current general-purpose flagship: tool use and vision, with server-side caching of the prompt prefix.

good_choices.label: economical
good_choices.note: Much cheaper per turn; enough for routine edits and questions.

good_choices.label: widely available
good_choices.note: A stable earlier generation, useful when an account has no access to the current flagship.

good_choices.label: recommended for tool use
good_choices.note: Function-calling capable and inexpensive, with server-side prefix caching. Text only - no vision.

good_choices.label: reasoning
good_choices.note: Deeper reasoning, but tool-call support is weaker than deepseek-chat, so run-code may not work.

good_choices.label: flagship
good_choices.note: Newest GLM text model: tool use, no vision. Pick a V model (glm-5v-turbo, glm-4.6v) if images matter.

good_choices.label: economical
good_choices.note: Faster and cheaper than the flagship for routine turns.

good_choices.label: stable
good_choices.note: The previous generation, still widely available on older plans.
